label: GO step, strongly committed to a2 (mid-episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass) and essentially only when the agent chooses a2 with a strongly negative policy logit (choice < -6 covers 100% of activations/mass, precision 0.33); nearly always a stay on a2 (prev_action a2 or window start), almost never after a1. Never fires at D1 or D2, nor on a1 choices. Rate also depends strongly on episode time: near zero in trials 0-9 and 80-99, peaking in trials 50-69; adding ep_trial 30-79 raises dev F1 from 0.49 to 0.64 (mass recall 0.84). Within a run of a2 stays the activation tends to be largest on the first stay after a rewarded common a2 trial and decays over subsequent stays. Precision remains incomplete: many confident a2 GO steps do not cross threshold, so the unit likely carries a2-commitment plus a slow drifting signal in magnitude. Uses only the agent own policy and trial index (no future variables); the future action==2 version scores similarly (F1 0.46).
